name: render_mesh_transform
rationale: Render-pass 3D geometry transform: loads rotation+translation matrices and perspective-projects a mesh's vertices (RotTransPers4 = 4-vertex batch) using the scratchpad vertex buffer; driven by scene_render_driver.

name: mover_actor_update
rationale: Per-frame update of a mover actor: integrates movement + collision, computes a heading (atan2_heading), queries its collision sector, and can spawn drops; called by mover_updater.

name: gameplay_effect_spawner
rationale: Gameplay-driven effect burst: loops (up to 11) spawning FX objects + contact objects and playing sounds; invoked from gameplay_state_machine.

name: consume_flag_37
rationale: Reads the byte at obj+0x37, clears it to 0, and stores its previous value to obj+0x38 (a read-and-clear latch / one-shot flag consume).
